645-728-804-1267.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
645-728-804-1267.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Sakashima the Impostor from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a nonlegendary copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Sakashima the Impostor.
Sakashima the Impostor triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Sakashima the Impostor
Repeat each turn.

465-618-728.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the Wormfang Drake token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the Wormfang Drake token.
When the Wormfang Drake token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

2301-2738-3967-4871.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Abzan Ascendancy, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Abzan Ascendancy trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Repeat.

824-997-2728-6854.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Leech Bonder is tapped and does not have summoning sickness.
824-997-2728-6854.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
824-997-2728-6854.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Leech Bonder's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Host of the Hereafter and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 4.

225-851-3129-4365-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

4762-7821-7823.easyPrerequisites: You control two or more Elves.
4762-7821-7823.description:
Activate Thranduil using Timberwatch Elf's ability by tapping it, giving Thranduil +1/+1 until end of turn for each Elf you control.
Activate Thranduil using Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.
4762-7821-7823.notes: Once Thranduil has infinite toughness, you can use Devoted Druid's first ability instead in step 1, or target other creatures using Greenhilt Trainee's ability.

3249-4647-5173-5686.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}
Repeat.

876-5840-7070.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Nantuko Elder.
Monk Gyatso triggers. Choose not to airbend Nantuko Elder.
Resolve Lightning Greaves' ability, attaching it to Nantuko Elder.
Activate Nantuko Elder by tapping it, adding {C}{G}
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Monk Gyatso.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Nantuko Elder.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Nantuko Elder.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Nantuko Elder from exile by paying {2}.
Repeat.

2232-3542-4541-5705.manaNeeded: {1} if you control fewer than eight Treasures
2232-3542-4541-5705.easyPrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}
2232-3542-4541-5705.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven Treasures.
2232-3542-4541-5705.description:
Activate at least seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding at least {7}.
Cast Marut by paying at least {7} gained from Treasures, plus an extra up to {1} if needed.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Cloudstone Curio and Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Palinchron from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Glaring Fleshraker trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve Marut. When Marut enters, it triggers, creating a Treasure for each mana from a Treasure spent to cast it.
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{U}{U}
Cast Palinchron by paying its mana cost.
When Palinchron enters, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Marut from the battlefield to your hand.
If needed, activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
2232-3542-4541-5705.notes: If you control eight or more Treasures, use eight Treasures to cast Marut, which foregoes step 12.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3033-3967-6972.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Vengeful Vampire
When Vengeful Vampire dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Vengeful Vampire
When Vengeful Vampire dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Yahenni abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
3033-3967-6972.notes: If Vengeful Vampire starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

4046-7070-7444.description:
Activate Outrider en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Outrider en-Kor.
The Outrider en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Outrider en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Advanced Reconstruction.
Repeat.

1563-2457-4460-6753.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

1402-2218-4742-4763.description:
Cast Diamond Lion by paying {2}.
When Diamond Lion enters, Ronin Warclub triggers, attaching itself to Diamond Lion.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
When Diamond Lion dies, Koll triggers, returning Diamond Lion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

339-677-4742-6974.manaNeeded: {3} if Ashling's Command is in your hand
339-677-4742-6974.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
If Ashling's Command is in your graveyard, activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Ashling's Command from your graveyard without paying its mana cost. Otherwise, cast Ashling's Command by paying {3}{U}{R}.
Resolve Ashling's Command, creating a token copy of Jegantha and choosing any of its remaining modes.
Put the tapped Jegantha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat using the Jegantha token.

2034-4871-5795-6201-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Barkform Harvester by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Sunscape Familiar.
Repeat.

3053-4067-5181-6281.easyPrerequisites: There are at least three basic land types among lands you control
3053-4067-5181-6281.description:
Activate Prismatic Geoscope by tapping it, adding at least {2}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Golgari Findbroker.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Golgari Findbroker that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Golgari Findbroker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Golgari Findbroker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Prismatic Geoscope.
Repeat.

2457-2557-4321-5794.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating four tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the four tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

2921-4112-4375.description:
Cast Sharuum either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{W}{U}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Sharuum enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Technomancer.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Sharuum.
Resolve the Sharuum trigger, returning Technomancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Technomancer.
Resolve the Technomancer trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Sharuum from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

1335-2034-2850.description:
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Elemental creature token.
Ivy Lane Denizen triggers, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on Marath.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Elemental, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

647-5299-5921-5970--112.notablePrerequisites:
Mirror Room is locked.
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
647-5299-5921-5970--112.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a token copy of Marina.
Put the tapped Marina into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Marina token enters the battlefield, it's first ability triggers twice, causing you to look at the top seven cards of your library and put all enchantment cards from among them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library, and then repeat this once.
Resolve the second Mirror Room trigger, creating a token copy of itself, as it is a creature due to Opalescence.
Activate the Marina token by tapping it, unlocking the token Mirror Room.
Repeat from step 2.
647-5299-5921-5970--112.notes: The chosen anthem must increase the toughness of the Mirror Room token so it does not die as it enters the battlefield.

1479-3585-5700-5701-6664.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3585-5700-5701-6664.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Greensleeves trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Greensleeves trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Greensleeves triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Greensleeves trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Greensleeves triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

81-1339-2122-4050.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
81-1339-2122-4050.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's first ability by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing an Insect, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2281-2511-3305.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Body Launderer.
When Saffi dies, Body Launderer's first ability triggers, causing it to connive.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Body Launderer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Body Launderer trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

803-1429-5256-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
803-1429-5256-5402.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

372-1309-3647.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Displace exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1309-3647.description:
Cast Displace by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Salvager of Secrets and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Salvager of Secrets trigger.
Resolve the Salvager of Secrets trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Displace.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Salvager of Secrets and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

2232-3908-6103-6104.description:
Cast Illusion of Choice by paying {U}, causing you to choose how each player votes this turn and drawing a card.
Cast Spark Double by paying {3}{U}, having it enter as a nonlegendary copy of Cirdan the Shipwright.
When Spark Double enters, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Cirdan the Shipwright to your hand.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger, having all players vote for any player other than yourself, causing those players to draw cards and you to put Cirdan the Shipwright onto the battlefield.
When Cirdan the Shipwright enters, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Spark Double to your hand.
Resolve the Cirdan the Shipwright trigger, having all players vote for any player other than yourself, causing those players to draw cards and putting Spark Double onto the battlefield as a copy of Cirdan the Shipwright.
Repeat from 3.

3560-6023.description:
Cast Archon of Sun's Grace by paying its mana cost.
When Archon of Sun's Grace enters the battlefield as an enchantment due to Secret Arcade, it triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield as an enchantment due to Secret Arcade, Archon of Sun's Grace's second ability triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat step 3.
3560-6023.notes: This combo creates a mandatory infinite loop at step 4 that will cause the game to end in a draw if it is not interacted with. It is highly recommended to only begin the combo if you have a way to break it.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2038-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Kozilek's Predator.
When Kozilek's Predator enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating six 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate three Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

969-1170-1328-2105.notablePrerequisites:
You have an instant card exiled by Spellbinder's imprint ability that has legal targets, if needed.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Spellbinder attached to any creature except Combat Celebrant that does not have summoning sickness.
969-1170-1328-2105.description:
Declare Combat Celebrant and the creature with Spellbinder attached as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Spellbinder attached.
Spellbinder triggers, causing you to copy a card exiled with it, and cast the copy without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Resolve the spell cast in step 4.
Repeat each combat phase.

1032-2178-5136.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
1032-2178-5136.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

2084-3388.notablePrerequisites: Moritte of the Frost is a copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm.
2084-3388.description: Activate Moritte of the Frost by paying {1}{U}, shuffling Moritte of the Frost into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

353-2034-4050.manaNeeded: {2}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
353-2034-4050.notablePrerequisites: Your storm count is equal to or higher than five plus the number of times you've cast Aeve from the command zone this game.
353-2034-4050.description:
Cast Aeve from the command zone by paying {2}{G}{G}{G} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Aeve's storm ability triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of itself for each spell you've cast previously this turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing the nontoken Aeve and two Aeve tokens, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Choose to have Aeve returned to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Aeve token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 5 until you have enough mana to cast Aeve.
Repeat from step 1.

1676-4050-5224.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures.
1676-4050-5224.description:
Cast Boss's Chauffeur by paying {4}{W}, causing it to enter the battlefield with at least five +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Boss's Chauffeur.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Boss's Chauffeur, adding {W}.
When Boss's Chauffeur dies, its second ability and Together Forever trigger.
Resolve the Boss's Chauffeur trigger, creating at least five 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.
Resolve the Together Forever trigger, returning Boss's Chauffeur to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate Phyrexian Altar five times by sacrificing five Citizens, adding {5}.
Repeat.
If you control five or more creatures to start the combo, this combo will net infinite Citizen tokens, infinite +1/+1 counters on Boss's Chauffeur and infinite colored mana.

2178-3621-4331-5256.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Drafna.
Drafna does not have summoning sickness.
2178-3621-4331-5256.description:
Cast Su-Chi Cave Guard by paying {8}.
Holding priority, activate Drafna's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, copying the Su-Chi Cave Guard spell.
Resolve the copy of the Su-Chi Cave Guard spell, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Su-Chi Cave Guard token.
The token Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, triggering itself and Drafna.
Resolve the Su-Chi Cave Guard trigger, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Drafna trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, milling any player eight cards.
Repeat from step 2.

228-678-1778-3701.description:
Activate Skullclamp's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Memnite.
Memnite dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness, triggering Enduring Renewal and Skullclamp.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Memnite from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Skullclamp trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Repeat.
